title: The Vigil of the Bereaved
intro: You are about to encounter a soul tested by the deepest separation, whose eyes knew the language of tears yet whose heart never lost hope. In a story of deception, longing, and eventual reunion, this noble servant of Allah became a symbol of patience for all time. Who endured the years of hidden pain, only to have sight and joy restored in a single moment?
clues: I am a prophet whose name became a symbol of patience in the face of great loss.
I was blessed with many sons, but one was taken from me by the jealousy of others.
My love for that lost one was so profound that my eyes turned white from grief, yet I never complained except to Allah.
I sent my sons back to search for the one I had lost and his brother, urging them not to give up hope.
When the bearer of good tidings arrived, a shirt was cast over my face, and suddenly the world became clear again.
I am known as Israel, and from my twelve sons came the twelve tribes of a great nation.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Separation from a beloved son for many years
Being thrown into a blazing fire
Afflicted with a severe skin disease
trial.answer: Separation from a beloved son for many years

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Sight restored and reunited with his son
Granted victory over a tyrant king
Appointed as a ruler over Egypt
Given a son in old age as a miracle
outcome.answer: Sight restored and reunited with his son

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
